// Writer-channel corpus for the taint engine (TestTaintFollowsWriters). A
// generic io.Writer parameter is not the terminal: the stream Run plugs into it
// lands in whatever each CALLER passes. A strings.Builder carries it on;
// os.Stderr and an options struct holding cmd.OutOrStdout() end it. A writer
// parameter nothing calls is an escape, a package variable only ever holding
// os.Stderr is terminal, and one also reassigned to a builder is not. An object
// plugged in through io.MultiWriter receives the stream through its own Write.
package writer

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// Run plugs w into the command: whatever w is receives the stream.
func Run(c *exec.Cmd, w io.Writer) error {
	c.Stdout = w
	return c.Run()
}

func intoBuilder(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	var b strings.Builder
	_ = Run(c, &b)
	return errors.New(b.String()) // WANT taint
}

func intoStderr(c *exec.Cmd) error { return Run(c, os.Stderr) }

type options struct{ Out io.Writer }

func intoOptions(cmd *cobra.Command, c *exec.Cmd) error {
	opts := &options{Out: cmd.OutOrStdout()}
	return Run(c, opts.Out)
}

// Orphan writes into a writer no caller in the program hands it.
func Orphan(c *exec.Cmd, w io.Writer) error {
	c.Stdout = w // WANT taint
	return c.Run()
}

var logOut io.Writer = os.Stderr

func intoPackageVar(c *exec.Cmd) error { return Run(c, logOut) }

var sink io.Writer = os.Stderr

var captured strings.Builder

func redirect() { sink = &captured }

func intoReassigned(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	return Run(c, sink) // WANT taint
}

// headBuffer keeps the head of a stream it is teed into.
type headBuffer struct{ buf strings.Builder }

func (h *headBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { return h.buf.Write(p) }

func printHead(w io.Writer, h *headBuffer) { fmt.Fprint(w, h.buf.String()) }

func teeLeak(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	var head headBuffer
	c.Stdout = io.MultiWriter(os.Stderr, &head)
	if err := c.Run(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("run: %s", head.buf.String()) // WANT taint
	}
	return nil
}

func teeClean(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	var head headBuffer
	c.Stdout = io.MultiWriter(os.Stderr, &head)
	if err := c.Run(); err != nil {
		printHead(os.Stderr, &head)
		return errors.New("the command failed; its output is above")
	}
	return nil
}
